_readme: Example format for `caption_fixes` in your profile.json.
reel-forge ships with an EMPTY fix list on purpose. Mishearings depend on your
language, your accent and your vocabulary — somebody else's list is noise in
your captions, and can corrupt words you actually said.
Build yours one entry at a time: every render where whisper mangles a word,
add the pair. After a dozen pieces the list stops growing.
Each entry is [regex_pattern, replacement]. Backslashes are doubled because
this is JSON. The patterns run in order, after any global fixes.
_patterns_that_earn_their_place: Proper nouns: your name, your company, your product, people you mention often.
Field jargon: the terms whisper has never seen in your domain.
Acronyms: models lowercase them or spell them phonetically.
Accents and diacritics dropped by the model in your language.
Homophones the model resolves the wrong way in your usual context.
_cautions: Anchor with \b so you do not rewrite the inside of longer words.
Prefer a longer, more specific pattern over a short greedy one.
A fix that needs surrounding context to be correct is a fix that will
eventually corrupt a line — leave those for manual review instead.
